sections.Profile:
Punny Factory, released by Pinball Adventures in 2023, is an original pinball machine that offers a unique adventure with every play. The game features a single-level playfield designed by Dave Sanders, equipped with two flippers, a Vari-target, three drop targets, three pop bumpers, a kickback, an up-kicker, and seventeen stand-up targets
